# Third-party artwork (local only)

This folder is for **optional, user-supplied** assets that OpenDashCAN does
**not** redistribute.

## Honda splash logo

To show a Honda logo on the desktop boot splash (instead of the built-in
geometric homage), place a file you are licensed to use here:

```text
assets/third_party/honda_logo.png
```

Also accepted: `honda_logo.jpg`, `honda.png`.

**Honda® and the Honda logo are trademarks and/or copyrighted works of Honda
Motor Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.** OpenDashCAN does not claim ownership of
those marks and is not affiliated with Honda.

Do not commit official trademark files to git. See `docs/TRADEMARKS.md`.
